title: Blueprint site from compiled code: input
description: The input of `vbp code-site` (Informal.CodeSite.Project, src/VersoBlueprint/CodeSite/Data.lean): a project's declarations, module by module, as a tool read them out of its build. Positions are Language Server Protocol positions (0-based lines, UTF-16 columns). Fields other than the required ones may be left out or null.

title.description: The site's title (default: the README's first heading, else the Lake package name, else the root folder's name).

skipped.description: Modules left out of the data, with the reason.

hovers.description: What a reader sees on pointing at a constant the declarations' sources mention: its printed signature and docstring, each constant once.

texPrelude.description: TeX definitions (\newcommand lines) put before every formula of the statements, as a written Blueprint's tex_prelude.

source.description: The module's source file relative to the project root ('' when unknown).

name.description: The constant's name; a private one keeps Lean's _private prefix.

display.description: The name as written, when it differs.

signature.description: The printed signature, keyword and name included.

uses.description: Declarations of the project it uses: in its type (statement) or only in its value (proof).

external.description: Constants of other packages it uses.

occurrences.description: The constants its source mentions, where (as the module's .ilean file records them); isDef marks the constant's own declaration.

statement.description: A declaration's informal statement as the producer found it (a LaTeX blueprint, a docstring, ...). The texts are Markdown with TeX math between $...$ (inline) and $$...$$ (display); raw HTML in them is shown as text.

proof.description: The informal proof, in the same form.

title.description: A short name for the result, shown before the statement (Markdown, as the text).

source.description: Where the producer found it (for example tex or docstring); not shown.
